title: Yocto: ship a kernel patch, config fragment and overlay for raspberrypi0-2w-64

profile.have: a kernel patch adding drivers/media/i2c/mycam.c, Kconfig, Makefile and overlays/mycam-overlay.dts

prompt: I have a kernel patch and an overlay. How do I get them into my Yocto image for the Zero 2 W so the camera works at boot?
must: Reads SRCREV_machine/LINUX_VERSION from the layer (bitbake -e virtual/kernel) and makes the patch against that commit
Names the bbappend linux-raspberrypi_6.6.bbappend and explains why '%' would also attach to the 6.1 and 6.12 recipes
Adds the patch and a .cfg fragment through SRC_URI with FILESEXTRAPATHS, and the fragment includes VIDEO_DEV=y, V4L2_FWNODE=y, V4L2_CCI_I2C=y
Adds overlays/<name>.dtbo to RPI_KERNEL_DEVICETREE_OVERLAYS globally and the dtoverlay line via RPI_EXTRA_CONFIG
Provides layer.conf with LAYERSERIES_COMPAT and LAYERDEPENDS on raspberrypi
Runs or recommends check_layer.sh and kernel_configcheck, and states clearly that parse-time checks do not prove the image builds or boots
must_not: Edits meta-raspberrypi in place instead of using a bbappend in its own layer
Claims the image was built or booted
Hard-codes board facts (GPIOs, bus numbers) into recipes
verify: skills/elinux-yocto/scripts/check_layer.sh reports PASS for patch, cfg and overlay
